fato_historico: 867: Byzantine emperor Michael III is murdered in his chamber by his junior emperor Basil I.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to reflect on the shifts of power within your own heart today. Much like historical changes in leadership, you may find that it is a good time to release outdated roles and step into your authentic authority. Consider how you can cultivate peace and harmony amidst the changing tides of your personal landscape.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the grace of your own peaceful presence.
significado_numero: Represents the union of dualities and the balance of celestial forces.
conselho: Seek serenity by letting go of conflicts that no longer serve your growth.
